messages:
rachel_cs: Heads up — Sherpa onboarding spike this morning, p50 latency up from 120ms to 360ms after batch of new users. Saw 18% error rate on generation failures. Reviewing logs now.
sam_reliability: Ok, thanks. Any pattern on model or route? region? :thinking_face:
rachel_cs: Mostly EU region (ams). Traffic is a mix of chat+summarize calls, seq len ~150 tokens. Current route -> redwood-hosted default -> gptx-large-epoch1 (non-quantized).
kevin_se: Quick wins: 1) try int8 quant for gptx-large. 2) fallback to gptx-medium for chat-heavy short responses. 3) route EU traffic to dedicated pool during ramp.
kevin_se: Example canary payload to test quantized model:
```json
{"model":"gptx-large-int8","route":"eu-dedicated-pool","test_prompt":"Summarize: <sample>","max_tokens":64}
```
sam_reliability: +1 to canary. Also suggest enabling prefix KV caching for repeated user prompts (saw a lot of repeated system prompts). That will lower per-token work.
ops-bot: ::alert:: Alert created #INC-2024-137 — EU apps saw 3x p50 increase. Auto-scaler triggered 2x but still degraded.
rachel_cs: Can you take point @sam_reliability? I'll loop in AM to Sherpa CSM and schedule 30m sync with their eng tomorrow. Need a short runbook to propose for their renewal conversation.
sam_reliability: I'll run int8 canary on eu-dedicated now and monitor for regressions. Will post perf + quality diff within 30m. Assigning to @kevin_se for model-size fallback tests.
kevin_se: will run A/B: gptx-large-int8 vs gptx-medium. Check rouge/bleu proxies and token cost delta. I'll post a quick table.
rachel_cs: Great — also capturing feedback: Sherpa requested clearer cost impact numbers for any quant/model swap for renewal slides. I'll prepare numbers once we have canary metrics. :memo:
sam_reliability: Noted. If int8 quality delta <1% and latency down ~40% we'll recommend canary -> rollout. If quality >2% regress, we'll prefer model mix routing (short replies to medium, long to large).
kevin_se: quick note: if you need the exact CLI to start canary:
`rwctl route create --team sherpa --model gptx-large-int8 --pool eu-dedicated --weight 10`
sam_reliability: thanks. posting updates in 20.
rachel_cs: thanks team :pray:
